messages:
elaine: Quick sync — final pass on the product launch blog publish checklist. Need signoffs on benchmark claims, legal, HubSpot CTAs, webinar gating, and the hero quote. Target publish: Tue 09:00 PT. Can owners confirm by EOD?

matt: I can own HubSpot mapping + UTM params. Will push the mapping sheet in 30m: https://docs.redwood.ai/hubspot/mapping -> will tag when done. :white_check_mark:

sara: Legal will triage claims. FYI automated scan found a flagged line about '50% cost reduction' — need source or soften claim. pinging legal-bot for details.

legal-bot: Automated check: "50% cost reduction" flagged for missing citation; please add benchmark link or change to "up to 50%". See policy snippet: `claims must reference internal benchmark doc or external public study`.

jamal: I wrote the hero quote draft, adding two options in the doc. Prefer Option B for tone. Will drop in thread in 10.

kevin: Benchmark snippet ready for approval — short paragraph + graph. @sara I linked the raw eval in the doc (`/analysis/benchmarks/launch-v1.csv`). Let me know if we should redact model names for public post. :eyes:

elaine: Pushed gated registration flow for webinar — landing page draft is at /webinars/rdw-launch. CTA mapping: primary CTA = Register (hubspot form), fallback CTA = Watch recording. Matt, will need the form ID.

matt: Form ID added: `hs_form_7421`. UTMs proposed: utm_campaign=rdw_launch, utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic. I also added a small JS snippet to ensure query params persist on redirect.

kevin: For the benchmark language, propose: "In our tests, Redwood Dedicated reduced median per-token latency by up to 30% vs baseline on standard LLMs (internal test suite)." — Sara, is that ok?

sara: Prefer softening to "up to 30% in our internal tests" and we need the test suite link. Kevin, add the `/analysis/benchmarks/launch-v1.csv` link inline and we'll clear.

jamal: Hero quote Option B: "Redwood made deploying inference predictable — we treat latency, not just model size, as a first-class product." Shorten if needed.

elaine: Quick checklist (copying into thread):
```
- [ ] Legal signoff on claims (sara)
- [ ] Hero quote final (jamal)
- [ ] Benchmark snippet + source link (kevin)
- [ ] HubSpot CTAs + UTMs (matt)
- [ ] Webinar reg page + form ID (elaine/matt)
- [ ] Final QA smoke test (publish-bot)
- [ ] Post publish monitoring (eng-sre)
```

matt: All HubSpot/UTM items done, leaving a comment in the doc for QA to confirm tracking.

sara: Legal will sign if benchmark link is present and language softened. I'll review final hero quote to ensure no comparative claims against named competitors.

jamal: I'll edit hero quote to "predictable inference for production teams" and drop the more comparative phrase. Done.

kevin: Added the benchmark CSV link and a short blurb. Changed "median latency" to "median per-token latency" for clarity.

publish-bot: Smoke test scheduled for 2026-03-24T08:30:00Z. Will report back with status.

elaine: Great — looks like we're almost there. Owners: please mark your checklist items by EOD. If legal signs off tonight I'll lock the publish window. :pray:
